GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. It is seven o'clock in the evening and you arrive at a friend's house. What do you say? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Abend
   B. Gute Nacht
   C. Auf Wiedersehen
   D. Guten Morgen

2. What does "Hallo" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sorry, excuse me
   B. no
   C. yes
   D. hello (friendly)

3. What does "der Onkel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. family
   B. uncle
   C. mother
   D. brothers and sisters

4. Which sentence means "This is my sister"? (1 mark)
   A. Das ist mein Schwester.
   B. Das ist mein Vater.
   C. Das ist meine Bruder.
   D. Das ist meine Schwester.

5. Which sound repeats most in "Montags macht mir meine muntere Mutter mittags meistens Mus"? (1 mark)
   A. m
   B. k
   C. sch
   D. z

6. What does "der Löffel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bathroom
   B. house
   C. window
   D. spoon

7. What does "das Wohnzimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. living room
   B. spoon
   C. lamp
   D. cupboard or wardrobe

8. What does "die Gabel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. chair
   B. fork
   C. sofa
   D. table

9. Which day comes right after Samstag? (1 mark)
   A. Mittwoch
   B. Sonntag
   C. Donnerstag
   D. Montag

10. How is the "g" pronounced at the end of "Tag"? (1 mark)
   A. like g in go
   B. It is silent
   C. like k
   D. like j

11. Which sentence says your age correctly? (1 mark)
   A. Ich heiße zehn.
   B. Ich habe heute zehn.
   C. Ich bin zehn Kuchen.
   D. Ich bin heute zehn.

12. What number is "zwölf"? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 6
   C. 1
   D. 12

13. What does "die Bohne" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. meat
   B. onion
   C. bean
   D. supper

14. What does "das Fleisch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tomato
   B. meat
   C. orange
   D. carrot

15. What does "das Haar" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. eye
   B. hair
   C. tooth
   D. mouth

16. What does "der Mund" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. ear
   B. face
   C. mouth
   D. shoulder

17. What does "der Regen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. wind
   B. rain
   C. cloud
   D. snow

18. Which word is a temperature word? (1 mark)
   A. kalt
   B. Regen
   C. Wolke
   D. Wind

19. What does "sehen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to see
   B. to sleep
   C. to smell
   D. to hear

20. What does "singen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to drink
   B. to read
   C. to sing
   D. to hear

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. A child arrives at school in the morning. Write in German what the child says to the teacher, and how the teacher asks how the child is, and the child's answer. (4 marks)

22. Give two reasons why fruit and vegetables are good for the body. (2 marks)

23. Write four short German sentences that a child could say about his or her birthday. (4 marks)

24. Name two ways to make the kitchen safer at home. (2 marks)

25. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bread, egg, tomato, water. (4 marks)

26. Write the German words with der, die or das for: head, eye, mouth, hand. (4 marks)

27. Write the German birthday wish "All the best for your birthday". (2 marks)

28. Give two reasons why imitating a teacher or a recording helps when learning German sounds. (2 marks)

29. You hear "Auf dem Mount Kenya ist es kalt. Dort schneit es manchmal." What is the gist? (2 marks)

30. Write the German for: sun, rain, wind, sky. Use der, die or das. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Guten Abend
   Abend means evening. Gute Nacht is only for going to bed and Auf Wiedersehen is for leaving.

2. D — hello (friendly)
   Hallo means hello (friendly).

3. B — uncle
   der Onkel means uncle.

4. D — Das ist meine Schwester.
   Schwester is a die word, so we say meine.

5. A — m
   Nearly every word starts with m.

6. D — spoon
   der Löffel means spoon.

7. A — living room
   das Wohnzimmer means living room.

8. B — fork
   die Gabel means fork.

9. B — Sonntag
   After Samstag comes Sonntag.

10. C — like k
   Tag is said TAHK.

11. D — Ich bin heute zehn.
   With age we use ich bin.

12. D — 12
   zwölf is the number 12.

13. C — bean
   die Bohne means bean.

14. B — meat
   das Fleisch means meat.

15. B — hair
   das Haar means hair.

16. C — mouth
   der Mund means mouth.

17. B — rain
   der Regen means rain.

18. A — kalt
   kalt means cold.

19. A — to see
   sehen means to see.

20. C — to sing
   singen means to sing.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen! Wie geht's? Gut, danke.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Guten Morgen, 1 mark for Wie geht's?, 1 mark for Gut, danke, 1 mark for capital letters and punctuation.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: They give vitamins and energy; they help us to stay healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich bin heute zehn. Ich habe einen Kuchen. Meine Familie ist da. Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep hot pots and matches away from small children; never leave the cooker alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Brot, das Ei, die Tomate, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kopf, das Auge, der Mund, die Hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for correct spelling and punctuation.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: We hear the right sounds and practise them again and again, so our mouth learns them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is cold on Mount Kenya and sometimes it snows there.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for cold, 1 mark for snow.

30. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, der Regen, der Wind, der Himmel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
